steps.title: Brief
steps.subtitle: The Strategist turns your answers into the brief every specialist works from.

idea.title: Decide the job before the post
idea.body: Most content fails because nobody decided what it was for. One job per batch, named before anyone writes.

action.label: Answer the brief questions in chat, then confirm.

steps.report:
## The brief

**Batch:** 10 static posts: **5 attention** and **5 conversion**. No trust-only posts in this batch.

**Format:** all **static slides**. You decided this up front, so at Step 6 we'll only confirm it for each concept. We won't ask the question again.

**Audience:** a **new mother who doesn't know Home Orbit yet**. She's cold: she's never seen the brand, has no reason to trust it yet, and she's scrolling.

**What counts as a win:** **assessment starts** and **waitlist sign-ups**. Views, likes and saves only matter if they lead to these two.

**Topic:** the research picks it. The Audience Researcher finds the real moments and the words mothers actually use. The Market Analyst uses the marketing-sophistication skill to find what the market has already heard too often and where the open lane is. Topics come from where those two reports meet.

**Required (your rule): every post gives real, usable value.** She leaves with something concrete she can use: steps to try, a way to answer a question she has, separate ideas she can pick from, or a short checklist. Vague information that doesn't help her is not allowed. This counts for attention posts too: the value *is* what stops the scroll.

### How the two jobs work together
| Job | Posts | What she gets | How it ends |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attention | 5 | A small, concrete win she can try today | No call to action, or at most a soft nudge to the profile |
| Conversion | 5 | Real value that also shows her the next question only *her own* observations can answer | One clear step: start the free assessment (with a matching `?focus=` link) |

### Assumptions to confirm
- Conversion posts send her to the **assessment**, and the waitlist comes after the assessment. They don't send her straight to the waitlist. *(Assumed because she's a cold mother: the assessment is the natural first yes.)*
- Value has to stay inside the content rules: practical steps for **her**, no promised result for the child, no clinical cause, no mention of therapy.
- Platform: TikTok/Instagram carousels, read on a phone.

steps.title: Scorecard
steps.subtitle: The Strategist sets this batch's 100-point scorecard and the agency plan.

idea.title: Define great before you make anything
idea.body: If you don't know what good looks like before writing, you'll grade whatever you made as good.

action.label: Review the weights and the plan.

steps.title: Research
steps.subtitle: The Audience Researcher and Market Analyst work in parallel.

idea.title: Her words, and what the market has already heard
idea.body: We write in the mother's own language, and aim where the 50 generic accounts aren't.

steps.title: Angles & hooks
steps.subtitle: The Hook Specialist writes 3 angles with 4–6 scored hooks each.

idea.title: The hook carries most of the result
idea.body: An angle is the way in; a hook is the exact first line that delivers it.

action.label: Pick or push back on the hooks.

steps.title: Concepts
steps.subtitle: The Strategist assembles distinct concepts for you to choose from.

idea.title: Options, never one answer
idea.body: You choose the set to test. Cut, combine, or ask for more.

steps.title: Format
steps.subtitle: You decide: static slides or video, per concept.

idea.title: The idea finds its shape
idea.body: Slides for connected points worth saving; video when the idea needs movement to land. Nothing gets written before this.

action.label: For each picked concept, tell us: static slides, video, or both.

steps.title: Production
steps.subtitle: The Copywriter writes every picked post in Arabic.

idea.title: Never from a blank page
idea.body: Each post starts from a picked concept, a chosen hook, a decided format and her own words.

steps.title: Arabic + Test
steps.subtitle: The Arabic Voice Editor, then three sceptical mothers score every post.

idea.title: Strong AND safe
idea.body: Lukewarm is invisible; unsafe is harm. Both fail.

action.label: Review the ranked posts and pick what ships.

steps.title: Handoff
steps.subtitle: The Strategist packages the final posts and seeds the performance loop.

idea.title: A batch ends when its results teach the next one
idea.body: Post, then tell us the numbers and say 'what's working?'.
